entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: Figure whose lost prophecy speaks of the Swarm rising to rule all.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes, where an ancient eye opens; one student says it took everything from her family.

entities.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
entities.description: A protector sworn to defend the people of Thraben, even from angels, who would rather be a heretic than betray her conscience.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A place Thalia guards and keeps safe.

entities.name: Captain Lannery Storm
entities.description: A pirate captain who speaks of ships going missing in the Stormwreck Sea.

entities.name: Stormwreck Sea
entities.description: A sea where ships go missing all the time.

entities.name: Valor's Reach
entities.description: A place whose entrance is watched by statues of its twin founders and first champions.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: A manor where vampires hold soirees.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A dragon whose subjects congregate in Ayagor.

entities.name: Surrak, the Hunt Caller
entities.description: A hunter whose duty is to keep Atarka's feeding bowl full.

entities.name: Ayagor
entities.description: The place where Atarka and her subjects congregate.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: A deity of harvest whose worshippers plant countless seeds.

entities.name: Queen Marchesa
entities.description: A queen who calls Brago a forgotten fool; many of her subjects have died for her.

entities.name: Brago
entities.description: A former ruler whose tomb is now the last memorial to a forgotten fool.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: A ruling power whose defeat opened the forges of Ghirapur to all.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: A city from which inventions pour forth.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian of great ingenuity whose domain hosts terrible experiments, and who welcomes a new Phyrexian Planeswalker.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian known for inhumanity.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker necromancer from Dominaria who sold her soul to four demons for powerful gifts.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon who gave Liliana power over death.

entities.name: Kothophed
entities.description: A demon who gave Liliana eternal youth carved into her skin as tattoos.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A demon who gave Liliana sway over the living.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: A monstrous being invoked as the ultimate foe.

entities.name: Rielle
entities.description: A teacher who promises a girl to teach her how to make the future brighter.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: A woman who could not stand by while Kamigawa suffered for her father's actions.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: A plane that suffered and was saved by Toshiro.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: A self-interested trickster who ended up saving all of Kamigawa.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: A powerful figure who held over a dozen oni in blood oath.

entities.name: Reki
entities.description: A man whose tattoos were transcribed after his death to write The History of Kamigawa.

entities.name: The History of Kamigawa
entities.description: A volume written from Reki's tattoos and stories.

entities.name: Kaito Shizuki
entities.description: A planeswalker ninja skilled with technology and blade, searching the Multiverse for his sister.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker who refuses to reveal where her son is.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A schemer working with someone after more than the Emperor.

entities.name: The Emperor
entities.description: A ruler who chooses to face the real enemy rather than be hunted.

entities.name: Xenagos, the Reveler
entities.description: A reveler who enjoys arson at parties.

entities.name: Greensleeves, High Wizard of the Domains
entities.description: A wizard who speaks of the spirits of the Whispering Woods.

entities.name: Whispering Woods
entities.description: A forest with mysterious, mercurial spirits.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: A land where slivers nested in great numbers.

entities.name: Hastric
entities.description: A Thunian scout who observes slivers.

entities.name: Merrik Aidar
entities.description: A member of a Benalish patrol beset by slivers.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A figure who speaks of sliver instincts and Skyshroud's depletion.

entities.description: A depleted land whose rangers fight slivers.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: A man of the Weatherlight.

entities.description: A ship whose timbers slivers broke against.

entities.name: Sliver Queen
entities.description: The lost progenitor of the slivers.

entities.name: Volrath

entities.name: Rath

entities.name: Endrek Sahr
entities.description: A master breeder of thrulls fascinated by slivers.

entities.name: Adom Capashen
entities.description: A Benalish hero who witnessed a sliver attack.

entities.name: Llanach
entities.description: A Skyshroud ranger who fought slivers.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel to whom travelers pray now that Avacyn is gone.

entities.description: An angel who is gone.

entities.name: Dakkon Blackblade
entities.description: Wielder of the Blackblade.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind mage from Vryn.

entities.description: Jace's plane of origin.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker pyromancer from Kaladesh.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker auramancer from Naya.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker summoner of unknown origin.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Liliana's plane of origin.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A power whose zealots live only for conquest.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A land to which night will one day come.

entities.name: Narvek Riag
entities.description: A kithkin prophet foretelling night coming to Lorwyn.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A figure of faith who unleashed her wrath in blinding light.

entities.name: Saheeli
entities.description: An inventor who works with Breya and loves someone in Ixalan.

entities.name: Breya
entities.description: An artificer who works with Saheeli.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A strategist who promises the city for eight walkers.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A stitcher whose messages are always bad news.

entities.name: House of Vess
entities.description: A house whose purple banner symbolizes death.

entities.name: Reito

entities.name: Kami War

entities.name: Darien

events.summary: Liliana Vess sold her soul to four demons in exchange for powerful gifts.
events.quote: She sold her soul to four demons for powerful gifts.

events.summary: Griselbrand granted Liliana power over death.
events.quote: Power over death was Griselbrand's gift.

events.summary: Kothophed granted Liliana eternal youth in the form of tattoos.
events.quote: Kothophed bestowed upon Liliana eternal youth, carved into her skin as intricate tattoos.

events.summary: Razaketh granted Liliana sway over the living.
events.quote: From Razaketh, Liliana gained sway over the living.

events.summary: After the Consulate's defeat, Ghirapur's forges were opened to all.
events.quote: After the Consulate's defeat, the forges were opened to all.

events.summary: Michiko acts against Kamigawa's suffering caused by her father.
events.quote: Michiko could not sit idly by while Kamigawa suffered for her father's actions.

events.summary: Toshiro, looking out for himself, ended up saving all of Kamigawa.
events.quote: Though only looking out for himself, Toshiro ended up saving all of Kamigawa.

events.summary: After Reki's death, monks spent ten years transcribing his tattoos into The History of Kamigawa.
events.quote: After his death, monks spent ten years transcribing the tattoos from Reki's body and gathering stories from those who spoke with him.

events.summary: Following his sister's clues, Kaito found his friend dead at a monster's hands.
events.quote: Kaito followed the clues his sister gave him, only to find his friend dead at the hands of a monster.

events.summary: Slivers multiplied in Otaria beyond their numbers on Rath.
events.quote: Within weeks, more slivers nested in Otaria than ever existed on Rath.

events.summary: Riptide wizards' magic killed the first wave of slivers, but the second was immune.
events.quote: The first wave of slivers perished from the Riptide wizards' magic. The second wave shrugged off their spells like water.
A bristling wave of slivers broke against the *Weatherlight's* timbers.

events.summary: Reito was destroyed in an early battle of the Kami War.
events.quote: Destroyed in one of the first battles of the Kami War, the town of Reito still grieved.

events.summary: Darien fulfilled his dream of unification and became the last king of Kjeldor.
events.quote: With his dream of unification fulfilled, Darien became the last king of Kjeldor.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias welcomes a newly compleated Phyrexian Planeswalker.
events.quote: "Wake up, new Phyrexian Planeswalker! You will not be the last." —Jin-Gitaxias

events.summary: Serra unleashed her wrath in blinding light.
events.quote: The skies parted, and Serra unleashed her wrath in blinding light.

events.summary: Saheeli and Breya bring their invention to life together.
events.quote: "That's it!" they exclaimed in unison as their vision sprang to life.
